posts.body:
Hi all,
First i did do a search and found a few other posts but none of them helped.
Im trying to run a test on a game but get a failed to load:img/faces/Harold.png error message, this images is in the folder and was generated by the RPG Maker MV Character creator and then exported out for use, i just dont know why it says it cant find it when it is in the folder.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
The error message doesn't say that it can't find the file.
It says that it can't load it, there is a difference.
the file could be damaged, or it could be a capitalisation error or a few other possibilities.
1) under HTML rules, Capitalisation makes a file different. A.png and a.png are two different files, because A is a different letter than a.
So do you have a file Harold.png or harold.png?
2) can you see the file extension? are you sure it's png and not PNG?
it has to be png, the engine can't load PNG files.
3) where is the image folder located? please give the full filepath beginning with the drive letter.
There are several errors that could be in the location of your project folder.

it is Harold.png and thats what shows on the error message as well
yeah i see file extensions and its .png
file path is C:\Users\win 10\Documents\Games\Dracotaur Legacy\img\faces *this is the project folder - when i click playtest it dose the error, even if i pack it as if finished it still errors*

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Spaces are not allowed in HTML5/Internet names. There is a reason why the underscore is used there.
Windows should have an override for that for local HTML files, but it randomly happens to fail sometimes.
So move the project folder to something like c:\games\dragotaur_legacy
and try to playtest there.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
Apparently, you included a plugin or modified existing classes directly in the JS files. Projects during development do not attempt to read rpgmvp files.
rpgmvp files are encrypted files that will only appear after deployment for distribution.
The best way would be to create a new project and move only the data, assets and additional plugins from that problematic project.

I dont understand what happened but least i can continue.. thank you

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
I tried to create a Plugin once and it always gave problems in certain situations in the game, I moved the Plugin to another project and it worked normally, then I realized that at some point just to test some native function I had done the motificing of it, but I didn't restore it and when I did and it must have been at least 2 years since I made this modification.
Never modify the JS files of your projects, I know it seems boring to create a Plugin that modifies one or more functions of a class, but in reality it is quite simple.
